queries.purpose: Full registry metadata + reviews + official evidence coverage + canonical Math mapping + current beta scopes
queries.query:
WITH data AS (
 SELECT e.*,u.name university_name,u.slug university_slug,u.is_active university_active,
 r.revision review_revision,r.state review_state,r.approval_requested,
 r.body->'package' p,r.body->'runtimeApproval' a,r.body->'documents' docs
 FROM public.essay_exams e JOIN public.universities u ON u.id=e.university_id
 LEFT JOIN essay_material_private.reviews r ON r.exam_id=e.id
)
SELECT d.id exam_id,d.university_id,d.university_name,d.university_slug,d.university_active,
d.admission_year,d.exam_name,d.exam_kind,d.field_or_division,d.session_label,d.exam_format,d.official_source_url,
d.verification_status registry_verification,d.is_active registry_active,d.question_count declared_question_count,
d.review_revision,d.review_state,d.approval_requested,
d.a->>'status' runtime_approval_status,d.a->>'revision' runtime_approval_revision,d.a->'question_ids' approved_question_ids,
d.p->>'package_digest' package_digest,d.p->>'verification_status' package_verification,d.p->>'review_scope' review_scope,

COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('question_id',q.id,'question_key',q.question_key,'label',q.label,'display_order',q.display_order,'is_published',q.is_published) ORDER BY q.display_order,q.id) FROM public.essay_questions q WHERE q.essay_exam_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb) registry_questions,
COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'question_id',q->>'question_id','source_key',q->>'source_key',
 'fk_match',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.essay_questions eq WHERE eq.id::text=q->>'question_id' AND eq.essay_exam_id=d.id AND eq.question_key=q->>'source_key'),
 'official_images_count',jsonb_array_length(q->'official_images'),
 'refs',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'role',f->>'role','source_hash',f->>'sourceHash','verification',f->>'verification',
 'question_id_match',f->>'questionId'=q->>'question_id','evidence_chars',length(btrim(f->>'evidenceText')),
 'document_attached',d.docs ? (f->>'sourceHash'),
 'provider_rights',d.p->'rights_status'->(f->>'sourceHash')->>'providerTransmission'
 )) FROM jsonb_array_elements(q->'source_page_references') f),'[]'::jsonb)
 )) FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.p->'questions') q),'[]'::jsonb) package_questions,
COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('leaf_id',l.id,'leaf_key',l.leaf_key,'question_id',l.essay_question_id,'problem_id',pr.id,'problem_set_id',ps.id,'problem_state',pr.state,'set_state',ps.state,'response_format',l.response_format,'canonical_fk',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.essay_questions eq WHERE eq.id=l.essay_question_id AND eq.essay_exam_id=d.id)) ORDER BY pr.display_order,l.display_order,l.id)
 FROM public.math_problem_sets ps JOIN public.math_problems pr ON pr.problem_set_id=ps.id JOIN public.math_subproblems l ON l.problem_id=pr.id WHERE ps.essay_exam_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb) math_leaves,
COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('campaign_id',b.campaign_id,'question_ids',b.question_ids,'has_math',b.has_math,'runtime_policy',b.runtime_policy,'approval_reference',b.approval_reference)) FROM essay_beta_private.exam_scope b WHERE b.exam_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb) beta_scopes
FROM data d ORDER BY d.university_name,d.admission_year DESC,d.field_or_division,d.session_label,d.id;

queries.query: WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id exam_id,essay_exam_private.runtime_policy(id) policy FROM public.essay_exams) SELECT exam_id,policy,CASE WHEN policy IS NOT NULL THEN essay_private.provider_binding_valid(policy->>'regime',essay_private.provider_policy(policy->>'regime')) ELSE false END provider_binding_valid FROM p ORDER BY exam_id;
